checks.label: relative_boundary
checks.condition: rG*p==rP and rP*inc==rG and rP*HP==0 and rG*HG==0

repairs: The x^3=0 DGA had zero arity-three residual and correction. The final x^4=0 DGA checks that both are nonzero before treating the arity-three identities as substantive.

The initial delayed definition of r(t)/t^2 evaluated at t=0 before cancellation. The final code evaluates the regular polynomial before substitution; the note gives the continuous Taylor integral extension.
